enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over onto side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Breathe deeply. Move legs. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering with hot water and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse off. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and getting ready for the day; checking emails and preparing for breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from bathroom to bedroom. Open wardrobe door. Select clothes. Take off sleepwear. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Close wardrobe. Sit at desk. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open email app. Read emails. Reply to one email. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 1; boiling the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Say 'Good morning' to Member 1. Fill kettle with water from tap. Place kettle on base. Press kettle switch. Open bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Open refrigerator. Take out butter and jam. Place on counter. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Wait for toast to pop. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Spread jam on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Talk to Member 1. Finish eating. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking emails and planning the day's arts administration tasks at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open email client. Read new emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Open task management app. Create task list. Write down tasks on paper. Prioritize tasks. Close email. Open document. Review notes. Make changes to task list. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely as an arts administrator on the computer, updating program schedules and replying to partner organisations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open spreadsheet. Update program schedule. Type in cells. Format cells. Save spreadsheet. Open email. Compose email to partner organization. Attach document. Send email. Answer phone call. Take notes. Open document. Review budget. Make changes. Send updated document. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send meeting invite. Check email again. Reply to another email.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a light lunch with Member 1; reheating food in the microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Say 'Hello' to Member 1. Open refrigerator. Take out food container. Open microwave door. Place container inside. Close door. Set timer to 2 minutes. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open door. Take out container. Stir food. Sit at table. Eat with Member 1. Talk to Member 1. Finish eating. Place dishes in sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighbourhood with Member 1 for fresh air and a coffee
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Put on jacket. Open front door. Step outside. Walk down path. Turn left. Walk along sidewalk. Cross street. Walk to coffee shop. Open door. Order coffee. Pay. Wait. Receive coffee. Walk out. Walk back. Enter house. Remove shoes. Remove jacket.

enriched_activities.activity: Freelance illustration work at the desk, sketching and inking commissioned pieces on the monitor and computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Open illustration software. Create new canvas. Pick up stylus. Sketch rough outline. Adjust brush size. Use eraser. Draw details. Zoom in. Ink lines. Use different layers. Save file. Open reference image. Compare. Continue inking. Save again. Zoom out. Review. Make adjustments. Save final.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a break, watching TV and resting on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch more. Stand up. Go to kitchen to get water. Return. Sit down. Continue watching.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration work under the desk lamp, refining client artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open file. Use stylus. Refine lines. Adjust colors. Use blur tool. Save. Zoom out. Review. Make more adjustments. Save again. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 1 on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Say 'What should I chop?' to Member 1. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Place on cutting board. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Wait for oil to heat. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Stir. Cover pan. Simmer. Turn off cooker. Talk to Member 1.
Sit at table. Serve food onto plates. Pick up fork. Eat. Talk to Member 1. Drink water. Continue eating. Finish. Place fork down. Pick up plate. Carry to sink. Return to table. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Lean back. Talk to Member 1. Pick up phone. Check social media. Show something to Member 1. Laugh. Put down phone. Stretch. Adjust cushion. Continue talking.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing freelance illustration work under the desk lamp, refining client artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open file. Use stylus. Make adjustments. Save. Close software. Turn off computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night-time hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off water. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in Bedroom 2, browsing design references on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open browser. Type design inspiration in search. Scroll through images. Tap on image. Zoom in. Save image. Scroll more. Close browser. Open social media. Scroll. Put down phone. Lie down. Pick up phone again. Continue browsing.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading quietly and winding down before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up book from shelf. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Adjust sitting position. Read. Close book. Stand up. Place book back on shelf. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Turning on the space heater, dimming the desk lamp and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on space heater. Walk to desk. Turn desk lamp switch to dim. Turn off main light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
